description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log messages, passing only the message content downstream in a logging chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that outputs only the message part of logs, omitting metadata for simpler display or processing.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters and forwards the log message to the next node, suppressing metadata.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
